ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Ash'karr Flora
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
TREE_GRAPHICS_OWNERSHIP_1: our own tree art at our own scale, per the owner's ruling — "generate our own tree graphics at the scales we want and drop all the nonsense of multiple tree mods modifying our designs to who-knows-what scale." Ships `RUT_SweetlineTree` (`design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/arid_shrubland.md` §4 "The sweetline, and the gradient that reverses" / "The sweetline trees" — "huge, ancient, powerful things... never small trees"), a fresh ThingDef with its own generated art and its own `plant.visualSizeRange`.
Mechanism found and neutralized: three subscribed mods form a data-driven rescaling framework — `ChaoticEnrico.BetterTrees` (Harmony framework, `BetterTrees.TreeScaleTemplateDef`/`TreeTextureTemplateDef`, keyed strictly by `defName`) plus two texture packs that feed it templates, `Qux.Comigo.BetterTreesMod` and `Maal.BetterTreesMod` ("the whole Comingo tree thing"). Read from the live Workshop copies (not shippable here — see `items/TREE_GRAPHICS_OWNERSHIP_1.md`): every template is a `defName -> {texture dir | minScale/maxScale}` dictionary; there is no category- or thingClass-wide fallback in the data. `RUT_SweetlineTree` is a brand-new defName absent from all three mods' template lists, so it is structurally immune — nothing here needs BetterTrees to be uninstalled. `Patches/BetterTrees_SweetlineTree_Immunity.xml` adds a defensive `PatchOperationRemove` that strips any future `RUT_SweetlineTree` entry those three mods' templates might ever add, so an update to any of them can't silently reclaim our defName. It matches nothing today — that is by design and is a no-op until proven otherwise (a patch that matches nothing logs nothing).
Live check still owed (bridge held by another window at authoring time): spawn `RUT_SweetlineTree`, confirm it renders at its authored `visualSizeRange` (5.0~6.5, i.e. a canopy roughly 5-6.5 tiles wide at full growth) and that no BetterTrees console/log line mentions it.
MOVED 2026-09-24 (`LONGSHADE_RM_MOD_BUILD_1`, §7 Q8): the desert's cycle plant (previously shipped here as `RUT_Vorrel`/`RUT_VorrelFruit`/`RUT_VorrelSeedDish` plus its hediffs, thought and recipe) is no longer part of this mod. It moved into `mandrake.rm.longshade` and was renamed `RM_Vorrel*` — `src/RimMandrake/LongShade/Defs/{ThingDefs_Plants,HediffDefs,ThingDefs_Items, RecipeDefs,ThoughtDefs}/`. This mod now ships only `RUT_SweetlineTree` and its wool, and `RUT_Fuzz`/`RUT_AridShrublandVanillaReplacements` (the arid shrubland's own content) — no fauna-behaviors dependency remains.
SWEETLINE_WOOL_HARVEST_1 (2026-09-21) — the harvest arid_shrubland.md §4 promised and never shipped: `RUT_SweetlineTree` inherited TreeBase's destructive wood harvest, which fells a named landmark tree. Now ships `RUT_SweetlineWool` (`RUT_SweetlineTree_Items.xml`, ParentName WoolBase, shaped on `RSW_WoolBantha`) as the tree's harvestedThingDef, with `harvestAfterGrowth` set (0.05, vanilla's own non-destructive-harvest mechanism — `PlantProperties.HarvestDestroys` is `harvestAfterGrowth <= 0f`) so the tree survives every harvest and cut-plant job alike. harvestYield dropped 160→20: a rare hanging harvest, not lumber. Chose ACCUMULATE over a flat yield — the wool is *shed* by passing giants, not grown by the tree, and it is the cheaper build besides (one existing PlantProperties field, already used twice elsewhere in this mod). Unblocks `SHRUBLAND_TREE_GUARDIAN_1`. Naming is provisional off "sweetline"/"giant- wool", never off a giant species name — the giants are still unnamed (`ARIDSHRUBLAND_SHIPPING_NAMES_1`). Art owed, not queued (Codex quota-blocked until ~2026-09-26); texPath points at the future render location per this mod's own established convention.
